content: Touch tree selection (verified W3C WCAG 2.5.8 + ARIA APG): target minimum 24x24 CSS px (AA), 44x44 for AAA 2.5.5 and platform conventions (iOS 44pt, Android 48dp); APG tri-state checkbox uses aria-checked true/false/mixed where parent mirrors group state, Space routes through the same pipeline as click, activating mixed parent checks all (unchecking clears all, optional remember-partial third state). Mobile adaptation: full-row tap targets, disclosure chevrons separate from checkbox hit area, sticky pinned summary + primary action.
